notes: Account background: Summitline SupportOps is a European contact center platform serving mid-sized telco and retail clients. Currently uses Genesys Cloud + custom ticketing. Looking to upsell existing Redwood usage (embeddings for KB search) to a company-wide contact-center stack. Primary goals: agent assist (real-time drafting + suggested responses), automated ticket summarization (end-of-day TLDRs), tool-calling into internal CRM for ticket actions, and robust reliability under peak sale events. Requirements summary: - Latency SLO: agent assist end-to-end < 400ms for suggestion latency (aim <300ms for short replies), summarization can be async up to 3s. - Throughput: baseline ~20k messages/day, peak spikes up to 1.5k concurrent agents during promotions. - Cost sensitivity: moderate; willing to buy reserved capacity if unit economics clear. - Model preferences: open-models preferred (Redwood-verified LLM variants); require model pinning + deterministic fallback to smaller quantized variant when capacity constrained. - Routing/fallback: need EU-region Dedicated nodes with automatic fallback to a different EU region and then to hosted fallback if Dedicated saturated. - Integration: must integrate with Genesys (webhooks) and internal ticketing (tool-calling API), and support structured JSON responses for ticket updates. - Security/compliance: GDPR + DPA required, SSO via SAML, audit logs retention 12 months, KMS for key management, per-tenant data residency in EU. POC notes: customer will provide representative traffic and sample transcripts; wants side-by-side latency & cost dashboard from Redwood Console; also requested a quick-eval of Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization profiles. Quote from CTO: "We need something that just works during the Black Friday-style spikes — graceful degradation, not blackouts."
